name: neobrutalism-badges
title: Badges
description: Neobrutalism-style badge components built with Tailwind CSS. Featuring thick borders, hard shadows, and bold typography. Ideal for labeling content, status indicators, and tags with a distinct, retro aesthetic.
useWhen: Applying a compact, high-contrast label to a status, category, or small piece of metadata.
Adding a visually emphatic tag within a bold card or list interface.
avoidWhen: The text is the primary content and needs paragraph-level readability.
The label must carry complex actions or explanations.
responsiveBehavior: Badges keep intrinsic width and wrap to the next line alongside surrounding text. Status badges preserve text labels at every width.
accessibility: Status meaning must be present in text, not only badge color.
Dismissible badges need a labelled button and must remain keyboard reachable.
